summary: Russia launched a massive drone offensive with over 350 Shaheds from Kursk over 11 hours, targeting Kyiv's CHP-5 with a Geran-5 missile and striking multiple regions. Ukraine completed a humanitarian evacuation from Oleshky, Kherson region, under a local ceasefire. A Russian oil refinery in Ufa caught fire after a reported Ukrainian drone attack.

sections.executive_summary: Russia launched a massive drone offensive with over 350 Shaheds from Kursk over 11 hours, targeting Kyiv's CHP-5 with a Geran-5 missile and striking multiple regions. Ukraine completed a humanitarian evacuation from Oleshky, Kherson region, under a local ceasefire. A Russian oil refinery in Ufa caught fire after a reported Ukrainian drone attack.

points: Ukraine conducted a successful humanitarian evacuation from Oleshky, Kherson region, establishing a local ceasefire, demining roads, and extracting civilians including a 94-year-old; evacuees crossed into Ukraine via Chernihiv region with US and Melania Trump mediation. (Source: @UkraineNow/85030, @UkraineNow/85021)

Ukrainian air defense detected and tracked numerous Shahed and Geran-5 drones across Kyiv, Cherkasy, Poltava, Vinnytsia, Khmelnytskyi, Ternopil, Zhytomyr, and Sumy regions, with specific sightings over Obolon at 50-100m altitude and over Ternopil city. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77669, @mon1tor_ua/77685, @mon1tor_ua/77688)

Ukraine's FP-7 ballistic missile (200kg warhead, 300km range) was combat-tested but considered economically unviable at $600k per unit compared to 16 FP-2 drones for same cost; cluster munition version may change calculus. (Source: @UkraineNow/85040)
Germany extended temporary protection for Ukrainian refugees until 2028, requiring military-age men to prove they are not evading service. (Source: @UkraineNow/85027)
US Embassy in Moscow warned of imminent terror threat at Tsaritsyno museum-reserve on 31 October, potentially causing mass casualties. (Source: @UkraineNow/85036)

Russia launched over 350 Shahed drones from Kursk region continuously for 11 hours, with additional launches from Shatalovo (7 groups), Orel (3 groups of jet UAVs), and Millerovo (4 groups). (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77687, @eRadarrua/127625)

Russian forces struck Kyiv's CHP-5 thermal power plant with a Geran-5 missile, and targeted multiple regions with Shahed and Geran-5 drones including Kyiv, Cherkasy, Poltava, Vinnytsia, Khmelnytskyi, Zhytomyr, Ternopil, and Sumy regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77653, @mon1tor_ua/77676, @mon1tor_ua/77680)
A major fire erupted at an oil refinery in Ufa, Russia, after a reported Ukrainian drone attack; local residents reported two plants attacked. (Source: @UkraineNow/85020)
Russian forces advanced near Mykolaivka on the eastern front, per updated frontline maps. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23951)

Russian Foreign Minister Lavrov was isolated at G20 summit as foreign ministers refused joint photo, with German FM Johann Wadephul stating no normality in relations with Russia. (Source: @UkraineNow/85022)
Enemy forces advanced near Mykolaivka, per DeepState map update. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23951)
Russian drone launches originated from Donetsk and Kharkiv regions toward Poltava region, and from Dnipropetrovsk region toward Cherkasy and Kirovohrad regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77684)
Multiple Shahed drones targeted Pavlohrad and Synelnykove in Dnipropetrovsk region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77680)
Jet UAVs (Geran-5) launched from Kharkiv region toward Poltava district. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77676)
Sumy region served as launch corridor for at least 6 UAVs toward Poltava region via Zavodske, and 4 new UAVs from Bilopillia toward Lypova Dolyna. (Source: @eRadarrua/127610, @eRadarrua/127635)
Chernihiv region used as transit for Shaheds toward Kyiv (Boryspil district) and Cherkasy (Cherkasy district). (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77676)
Russian forces launched 10 Shaheds from Sumy region toward Poltava's Lubny district, and 5 Shaheds from Sumy to Poltava's Lubensky district. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77681, @mon1tor_ua/77676)
Kyiv region experienced air raid alert at 00:39 with drone threat (yellow level), alert cancelled at 23:56 previous day. (Source: @eRadarrua/127651, @eRadarrua/127629)

Humanitarian mission in Oleshky, Kherson region, completed successfully with ceasefire, road demining, and evacuation of civilians and animals to Ukrainian-controlled territory via Chernihiv region. (Source: @UkraineNow/85030, @UkraineNow/85032)
UAV activity reported in Mykolaiv region: 3 UAVs near Kamianske, 1 past Shyroke toward Novyi Buh. (Source: @eRadarrua/127636)
Jet UAVs transited through Kirovohrad region toward Vinnytsia region presumably heading to Haisyn. (Source: @eRadarrua/127636)
Shahed drones entered Romania from Ukraine and from Romania into Chernivtsi region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77670, @mon1tor_ua/77672)

Massive coordinated drone wave: ±50 Shaheds moving simultaneously on multiple axes: Sumy→Poltava→Cherkasy/Kyiv→Vinnytsia→Khmelnytskyi; Donetsk/Kharkiv→Poltava, Dnipropetrovsk→Cherkasy/Kirovohrad→Kyiv→Zhytomyr/Vinnytsia. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77684)

Geran-5 missiles employed in strike role: 1 on Kyiv CHP-5, 1 from Kirovohrad to Cherkasy (Zvenyhorodka), 1 from Cherkasy to Kyiv (Obukhiv), 1 from Chernihiv to Cherkasy, 1 from Dnipropetrovsk to Kirovohrad (Kropyvnytskyi), 1 from Kharkiv to Poltava. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77676)

Detailed regional breakdown: 22 Shaheds from Kyiv/Cherkasy to Vinnytsia/Zhytomyr; 15 Shaheds from Kharkiv to Poltava; 10 Shaheds on Bila Tserkva; 8 Shaheds from Dnipropetrovsk to Kirovohrad (Oleksandriia); 6 Shaheds from Cherkasy to Kyiv (Obukhiv); 6 Shaheds from Kharkiv to Poltava; 5 Shaheds from Dnipropetrovsk to Kirovohrad with vector to Cherkasy; 4 Shaheds toward Pavlohrad; 3 Shaheds from Poltava to Cherkasy (Zolotonosha); 2 Shaheds from Chernihiv to Kyiv (Boryspil); 2 Shaheds from Vinnytsia to Khmelnytskyi (Shepetivka); 2 Shaheds from Kyiv to Zhytomyr (Zhytomyr district); 2 Shaheds north Vinnytsia to Khmelnytskyi; 1 Shahed circling over Zhytomyr; 1 Shahed from Kirovohrad to Cherkasy (Uman). (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77680)

Jet UAVs (reactive Shaheds) observed on multiple routes: Rivne→Lviv region; Kyiv→Zhytomyr (Korosten); Vinnytsia-Zhytomyr border→Khmelnytskyi; north of Cherkasy→Kyiv (Bila Tserkva); Khmelnytskyi→south Ternopil; Berdychiv→Khmelnytskyi. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77679, @mon1tor_ua/77680)
Launch sites identified: Shatalovo (7 groups), Orel (3 groups jet UAVs), Millerovo (4 groups), Kursk (>350 Shaheds in 11 hours). (Source: @eRadarrua/127625, @mon1tor_ua/77687)

Enemy ground forces advanced near Mykolaivka on the eastern front per updated mapping. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23951)
Ukraine's FP-7 ballistic missile combat-tested but deemed too expensive at $600k per unit versus 16 FP-2 drones for same cost. (Source: @UkraineNow/85040)
G20 foreign ministers canceled traditional group photo refusing to stand with Lavrov, signaling deep diplomatic isolation of Russia. (Source: @UkraineNow/85022)
sections.threat_assessment: Russia's sustained mass drone offensive from Kursk, exceeding 350 Shaheds in 11 hours, demonstrates an escalated attrition strategy targeting Ukrainian energy and population centers across a broad front. The use of Geran-5 missiles against Kyiv's CHP-5 indicates a shift toward higher-value standoff strikes on critical infrastructure. Simultaneous multi-axis transit routes through Sumy, Poltava, Cherkasy, Kyiv, Vinnytsia, and Khmelnytskyi regions aim to overwhelm air defense coverage. The humanitarian pause in Oleshky shows Ukraine can negotiate localized ceasefires, but the overall intensity suggests Russia seeks to degrade Ukrainian resilience ahead of winter.
sections.regional_response: Germany extended refugee protection until 2028 with stricter verification for military-age men, reflecting long-term commitment but domestic pressure. The G20 snub of Lavrov by European foreign ministers, led by Germany's Wadephul, underscores continued diplomatic isolation of Russia. Poland's internal constitutional crisis distracts from unified EU support. The US Embassy's specific terror warning in Moscow highlights intelligence sharing and potential asymmetric threats inside Russia.
sections.intelligence_notes: The FP-7 missile's combat test reveals Ukraine's developing indigenous long-range strike capability, though cost-effectiveness remains a constraint. The high volume of jet UAVs (Geran-5) alongside Shaheds suggests Russia is diversifying its drone arsenal with faster, more penetrative platforms. Launch
